title: Non-Send Futures in Multi-Threaded Executor
pattern: Constructing or holding a non-`Send` thread-local reference (such as `Rc` or `RefCell`) across an `.await` boundary in a future intended to be spawned on a multi-threaded work-stealing executor.
why_bad: Work-stealing executors dynamically shift tasks across worker threads. If a future contains non-`Send` types across `.await` points, it cannot safely move threads, resulting in compilation failures or localized bottlenecking.
detection: A future spawned via a multi-threaded run/spawn API that contains variables that do not implement `Send`.
